Generated from `templates/react-monorepo/template.json`. The apps are features
too: `app-auth` and `app-client` are on by default; `app-landing` and
`app-admin` are opt-in.

<FeatureTable template="react-monorepo" />

## Notes

- **Dropping `app-auth`** means another app must own `/login`: every guard and
  every 401 sends users to `VITE_APP_AUTH_HOST/login`.
- **`pwa`** and **`charts`** configure the client app only.
- **`types`** off removes generated types; apps then type their API calls by
  hand.
- The Dockerfile, CI matrix and `build.sh` follow the app set: only the apps you
  generate are built.
